titles.display: Kanabiso Pokuna Raja Maha Vihara

description: Buddhist temple in Monaragala District, Sri Lanka
extract: Kanabiso Pokuna Raja Maha Vihara is an ancient Buddhist temple in Monaragala District, Sri Lanka. The temple is located in Handapanagala village approximately 12 km (7.5 mi) distance from Wellawaya town. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. The designation was declared on 22 November 2002 under the government Gazette number 1264.
